watches.name: Rayquaza 3/17 Holo (POP Series 1)
watches._note: Pokemon vintage (2004 POP Series 1 promo, Cosmos Holo Rare). Identify by number 3/17 + the set (pop series / pop 1). 3/17 normalizes to '317', a short substring that collides with e.g. 13/17 ('1317') and 3/170 ('3170'), so pairing with 'pop series' is required for precision. 3/17 IS inherently the holo card (no non-holo print), so we don't require the word 'holo' (which would also match 'non-holo' via substring and hurt recall) — instead we exclude 'non holo' to drop any mislabels. Verified offline: 7/7 real titles matched (incl. terse + PSA 10), 5/5 confusables (non-holo, 13/17, 3/170, Charizard 3/17, proxy) rejected. watches.name: Espeon No.196 Crossing the Ruins (JP Neo Discovery) Holo
watches._note: Pokemon, Japanese. Espeon Holo Rare from the Japanese Neo Discovery set ('Crossing the Ruins' / 遺跡をこえて), printed as a bare running number 'No. 196' (no denominator). Identify by espeon + 196 + a set-name alt-list (crossing the ruins / neo discovery / neo2), plus a numberless fallback [espeon, 'crossing the ruins']. Bare 196 alone is unsafe (196 is Espeon's National Dex number, so it appears in modern Espeon ex/GX/VMAX listings) and is never used without the set name. CRITICAL: Neo DESTINY 'Dark Espeon' is ALSO Japanese No.196 — exclude 'dark'/'destiny' removes it (real Neo Discovery Espeon titles never contain those words); exclude 'umbreon' drops the Espeon 196 + Umbreon 197 pair/lot titles. exclude 'non holo'/'premium file' keeps it to the holo rare, dropping the separate Japanese 'Premium File' promo reprint (also No.196, but a cheap non-holo promo — confirmed on live listings). Verified offline through the full gate chain: 14/14 real holo titles matched (incl. CJK, PSA10, BGS9.5), 24/24 confusables (Dark Espeon keyword-spam/comparisons, English 1/75, modern dex-196 ex/GX/VMAX, Umbreon 197, Premium File promo, non-holo, sealed/jumbo/lot) rejected. Vintage PSA 8/9/CGC -> other_graded, won't alert.
queries: espeon crossing the ruins japanese holo
pokemon espeon no 196 neo discovery holo japanese
watches._language_note: language 'any': the JP-unique set name + bare No.196 gate it to the Japanese Neo Discovery print; 'japanese' would drop English-titled Japan listings with no CJK/'Japanese' word. A purely-CJK title (エーフィ only, no romaji 'Espeon') normalizes to just '196' and can't be matched — accepted limitation.

watches.name: Karen's Umbreon 091/141 (Pokemon VS, JP)
watches._note: Pokemon, Japanese. 2001 Pokemon Card VS set, Karen's Umbreon (カリンのブラッキー) #091/141, Holo Rare (JP-only, never English; 1st Edition and Unlimited both exist — not required, for recall). Identify by the FULL number 091/141 ('091141') or the unique name karen+umbreon, NEVER bare '091' (which collides with Paldean Fates Mew 232/091 and Mewtwo 216/091). match_any Sig A = umbreon+091/141; Sig B = karen+umbreon+091 (terse '#091' listings with no '/141' and no 'VS', e.g. the real '#091 PSA 10 Swirl'); Sig C = 091/141+vs (CJK titles that keep only Latin 'VS'+number). Verified offline through the full gate chain: 9/9 real titles matched (incl. CJK, PSA10, BGS9.5, both '#091' short forms), 17/17 confusables (232/091, 216/091, adjacent Karen's Tyranitar 090 / Flareon 089 / Houndoom 092, other Umbreons, VSTAR-'vs' & 091/195 decoys, proxy/metal, lot) rejected. A comparison title restating Umbreon's exact number ('...not the Umbreon 091/141') is an inherent substring-match edge. Vintage PSA 7/9/CGC -> other_graded, won't alert.
queries: カリンのブラッキー vs
watches._language_note: language 'any': the card is JP-only (no English print), so the unique JP number 091/141 and the unique name gate identity; most English-language listings of this card literally say 'Japanese', which 'english' would wrongly drop.

watches.name: Leafeon AR — Gem Pack Vol.2 (CBB2C-07 15/15, CN)
watches._note: Pokemon, Chinese (S-Chinese exclusive). Leafeon AR (叶伊布) from 'Gem Pack Vol.2', card CBB2C-07 15/15. The set's four ARs (Eevee CBB2C-01, Umbreon CBB2C-06, Leafeon CBB2C-07, Sylveon CBB2C-09) ALL carry 15/15, so identity rides on the Leafeon-specific code 07 + the AR number 15/15, NEVER '15/15' alone. match_any Sig A = 'cbb2c07' + '1515' (adjacent-code forms 'CBB2C-07 ... 15/15'). Sig B = leafeon + '071515' (the 07-code+15/15 number smushed, e.g. 'Leafeon AR 07 15/15 CBB2C' where the code is split, or 'Leafeon 07 15/15 Gem Pack Vol.2' with NO 'CBB2C' at all) + (gem pack | cbb2c) for set safety. Rejects the sibling ARs (they lack cbb2c07/071515) even when they name-drop Leafeon, AND the other Leafeon cards in the set (V 07 13/15, Masterball 07 09/15, 07 03/15, Star 07 06/15 — all lack 1515/071515). Verified offline (13T/12F, FN=0 FP=0) and live-scraped (76 real Leafeon AR matched, 0 FP, 0 recall miss). ACE/CGC-9.5/PSA-9 slabs bucket other_graded and won't alert.
queries: pokemon chinese leafeon gem pack vol 2 15/15
宝可梦 叶伊布 cbb2c-07 15/15
watches._language_note: language 'any': China-exclusive code/number-identified card (no English/Japanese print). _norm strips CJK, so matching rides on the Latin tokens (CBB2C-07 / 07 15/15 / gem pack) that real Chinese-seller and slab titles include; 'any' keeps the many CJK-tagged listings.
